sourceNotes.referenceTitle: Blue Rain Drop Glass Bangles (12 piece)
sourceNotes.rawContent:
Description:
Elevate your ethnic look with this royal blue glass bangle set adorned with delicate golden polka-dot detailing. Crafted from premium-quality glass, these bangles bring together traditional charm and contemporary elegance, making them perfect for any festive or special occasion.
The rich blue hue beautifully complements Indian outfits such as sarees, lehengas, and salwar suits, while the golden dotted accents add a subtle sparkle. Lightweight yet durable, these bangles are comfortable for all-day wear and ideal for weddings, festivals, and cultural celebrations.
Whether you're looking for bridal jewellery, festive accessories, or a thoughtful gift, this bangle set makes a timeless addition to any jewellery collection.
Key Features:
-
Elegant royal blue glass bangles with golden polka dots
-
Handcrafted for a traditional yet stylish appeal
-
Comfortable and lightweight for long wear
-
Matches with all festive and ethnic outfits
-
Perfect for weddings, parties, and gifting
